snapshot.objective: Preserve MD-OS operational identity and continuity through verified filesystem state, with private conversation carried only by complete folder copies.
completed_results: Cortex loads a hash-bound public operational snapshot.
Fresh threads load a bounded private tail without resuming provider history.
Successful turns append human and steering inputs plus the final answer to the private chronology.
Ordinary Git transfers exclude the private chronology; complete folder copies include it.
The workspace carries recorded operational identity; verified files and readback define target equivalence.
decisions: Canonical identity remains separate; this snapshot is non-canonical working context.
Private records omit reasoning, tool traces, model IDs, and thread IDs.
A fresh host reconstructs recorded state; copied host-local observations remain source-host evidence until rebuilt.
open_risks: A bounded history excerpt reaches the configured provider; offline inference needs a local model.
git add -f can bypass ignore; staged paths require inspection.
Turns predating this feature are not reconstructed.
Second-device migration is open; target credentials, dependencies, and device readback remain separate.
next_actions: Validate a physical copy on an independently provisioned second device.
